Scope: One local PC. Independent empty UI-test roots and synthetic task/candidate fixtures. Counts overlap. Not product maturity, cross-hardware calibration, model accuracy or long-term stability.

NativeVisual.Scope: Capacity table in the actual WPF visual tree with isolated synthetic rows. HTML content/values checked; no browser-rendering claim.

MemoryCases: Physical peak and commit remain separate
Insufficient and sparse readings do not create a baseline
Arbitrary GiB capacities and exact equal boundaries
Measured dates and capacity range retained
Display-only arithmetic does not invalidate reviewed candidate scope
Older selected-window memory peak survives recent light readings; narrower window excludes it

PrivateHistoryReview.Scope: Read-only local user-history copies; no fabricated representative confirmation, no source-file mutation, no upload or public user trace. Not independent human annotation.

LongRun: Existing frozen 0.8.25 run remains independent and does not validate 0.8.26.
